_doc: Registry of every hydra automation that can APPROVE Muso credit requests without a human choosing each request. scripts/check-credit-approval-automation.sh (CI: scripts/tests/check-credit-approval-automation.bats) fails if a cron in cron-jobs.json calls one of these entrypoints without being registered here, or is enabled while its entry has approved=false. dispatch-cv-batch.sh reads approved for credit-verification-batch and forces DRY (zero writes) unless it is true. Flipping approved to true is a captain decision: set approved_by and approval_ref (who said yes, and where) in the same PR.

credit-verification-batch.description: Lobster credit-verification pipeline (verify-credit-batch-mvp.lobster): approves signal_approve rows and moves the rest to user_verification_needed. Reached by the credit-verification-batch-4h cron and by the @Ops 'run credit verification' / 'verify profile' / 'verify credit' Slack triggers.
credit-verification-batch.status_note: DISABLED 2026-10-11 (firstmate containment, captain standing order 'we can't let bad credits into the system'). Its approve rule (approve_owning_track == 100 AND total_risk_percent < 80) was inverted: 100 means the validator's owning-track shortcut did NOT fire, so the rule approved validator-DECLINED rows with risk 30-80. Real apply stays blocked until the captain approves the fixed pipeline.

uvn-under30.description: scripts/uvn-under30-cron.py --mode apply: approves ticket-enrolled user_verification_needed rows with live Spotify popularity < 30 and no reject_*/review_* rule or batch fraud flag.
uvn-under30.approval_ref: 2026-08-13 authorization of the autonomous admin-write gate; apply mode + hourly from 2026-09-09 (recorded in the cron description in cron-jobs.json). This is Nick's approval as recorded, not a captain decision; firstmate to confirm or flip to false.
uvn-under30.status_note: From 2026-10-11 it also refuses rows with any review_* hold rule (IDP #1686) in verificationData.

credit-trust-decide.description: scripts/credit-review.py decide --mode apply (cron credit-trust-decide-15m): trust-yet-verify on the held (unverified) queue. Provisionally approves non-big rows with no validator conflict that have ONE evidence kind (all roles trusted-confirmed, a trusted footprint of >= 3 confirmed claims in each claimed role family, or Codex on server-fetched sources with verified quoted citations on >= 2 independent domains, never crowd-edited MusicBrainz/Wikipedia alone; editorial roles only on trusted catalog confirmation under pop 30), and moves the rest to user_verification_needed (Knock asks the user for proof). The fraud/PULL/HOLD/RE-VERIFY lists in policies/credit-trust-decide.json are never approved. Writes only via muso-admin-api.sh's conditional endpoint as credit-trust-decide@hydra-ops; the wrapper re-checks this entry at the write boundary and core-backend's agentApprovalGuard refuses any row with a validator conflict.
credit-trust-decide.approval_ref: 2026-10-15 ~22:12Z (verbatim, relayed by firstmate inbox 002/003): 'i want AI live now - we have too many credits to approve and to get supporting data for - let users know where there was a credit given and that it needs support (trust yet verify approach)'
credit-trust-decide.status_note: JUDGE-ONLY (Fable [key=switch-on-plan] item 3, firstmate 159, 2026-10-30 21:50Z): the WRITER is not approved (approved=false: muso-admin-api.sh refuses every apply write, and the writer kill file /etc/hydra/credit-trust-decide.disabled stays). The decider may run --mode judge only: decider rows in the ledger, no core write, no ask, no notify. Previously approved by captain (Aaron) (2026-10-15 ~22:12Z (verbatim, relayed by firstmate inbox 002...); re-approving apply is a captain decision in a reviewed PR. Wiring: data/credit-trust-system-fable-a1/live-tonight.md Piece 1 (Fable). Cron ships enabled=true from the repo (captain's 22:12Z approval above); there are no live toggles, because deploy.sh re-syncs cron-jobs.json on every deploy, so disabling it durably is a repo PR. Kill switches: /etc/hydra/credit-trust-decide.disabled (silences it), cron enabled=false, or approved=false here (the wrapper then refuses every approval).

judge_only.approved_by: Fable (switch-on plan, item 3) under the captain delegation

credit-trust-score-approve.description: scripts/credit-review.py score-approve --mode apply (cron credit-trust-score-approve-15m): executes the validator's own APPROVE verdict on held unverified / user_verification_needed rows whose total_risk_percent is < 30 (paid first, then risk 0, then oldest; at most 100 per run; caps 20/user, 50/profile, 2,000 fleet per day). Every other guard intact: no validator conflict, no reject_* rule, core's approval guard clear (band A; band B only after core's phase-1 twin is live, Fable 2026-10-20; a band-hint-only proof stamp is not an open ask unless the user engaged: proof on file, support email, Intercom conversation), popularity known, > 0 and < 60, no organization/label/publisher/studio role, user and profile not on the decider's deny/fraud/PULL/HOLD lists, per-user daily approval cap. Ledger before write (decisions.evidence_kind validator_low_risk); writes via the decider's conditional PUT (expected = the row's own held status, caps and pause re-checked under the write lock before every batch) as credit-trust-decide@hydra-ops; reversible per run (credit-review.py revert --run, named human). Provisional: verify-notify candidates (one v1 note).
credit-trust-score-approve.approval_ref: captain verbatim 2026-10-20 ~11:30Z "approve low risk credits" (data/captain.md) + Fable ruling data/credit-trust-system-fable-a1/ruling-score-approve-band-b-2026-10-20.md (band-B phase 1, 11 conditions) + Fable ruling data/credit-trust-system-fable-a1/ruling-band-hint-stamps-2026-10-20.md (non-sticky band-hint stamp, engaged-user exclusion)
credit-trust-score-approve.status_note: Relayed by firstmate inbox 110 (2026-10-20 11:31Z). Scope per firstmate: total risk < 30 only, every other guard intact, the 709 risk-0 rows first (Fable credit-pending-census ruling 1). Kill switches: /etc/hydra/credit-trust-score-approve.disabled (also honours /etc/hydra/credit-trust-decide.disabled), policies/credit-trust-decide.json score_approve.enabled=false, cron enabled=false, or approved=false here. Fable condition 10: an audit sample below 95 % precision pauses it at once (credit-review.py score-approve --pause <audit id>) and this entry flips to approved=false by PR until Fable reviews.

fable-decider.description: L12 executor (scripts/credit-fable-execute.py), never scheduled. Carries out Fable-ruled tray files on disk where EVERY row carries a Fable ruling id (else the whole tray is refused). TWO scopes: (1) CLOSES (action reject): unverified / user_verification_needed -> rejected, on the decider account (MUSO_ADMIN_IDENTITY=credit-decider) with X-Credit-Automation-Id fable-decider; guards on fresh Postgres facts: same status and user, not deleted, the cited reject_* still fires or a Fable R- rule with evidence, known not big (pop 1..59, not client-sourced), no live claim by the submitter on the profile, account gate allow, not watchlisted; cap 100/day (<= 400 only with a Fable cap ruling id). (2) APPROVALS (action approve; core FABLE_RULED scope, core #11010/#11011): unverified / user_verification_needed / rejected -> approved on Fable's OWN login (MUSO_ADMIN_IDENTITY=fable = agent-fable@muso.ai), admitted by core ONLY on a server-held fresh anchor record (credit_anchor_records, written by the DSP verifier's identity) on every claimed role, pinned in the approving UPDATE; executor guards: same status and user, known-small pop 1..59, account gate allow, not watchlisted; label-path approvals provisional 7 d; cap 50/day, counted separately from closes. Both: kill file /etc/hydra/fable-decider.disabled + this registry entry re-checked before every batch and at the wrapper boundary (verify_batch on a clean env), <= 100 ids per close call / <= 50 per approve call, read back from Postgres, one audit line per row (/var/lib/hydra/credit-review/fable-decider-audit.jsonl), stops on the first surprise. Never deletes.
fable-decider.approval_ref: captain-1028-213x: captain verbatim 2026-10-28 21:3xZ "move credits and profiles along ... if you get one fraud document deny ..." + 21:4xZ "yes approve all if Fable confirms" (data/captain.md:586); Fable exec plan data/verify-program-lead-fable-l1/exec-plan-captain-1028-213x.md section (a); Fable confirms data/verify-program-lead-fable-l1/confirms-captain-1028-214x.md; APPROVE scope: captain 2026-10-29 12:1xZ "ddl go" (anchor records: DDL GO ANCHOR RECORDS, firstmate 110) + Fable [key=l12-approvals-core] = option A and r3 [key=ddl-anchor-records-guards] (approvals <= 50/day, gate allow, not watchlisted, pop 1-59)

credit-dsp-verify-d5b.description: credit-dsp-verify.py d5b (Fable 171): same-run Spotify+Tidal captures and LOCAL dsp-anchor/1 records for doc-verify's verified requests. It approves nothing and writes no core state; it is registered because its anchor records are the approve-grade fact a later executor consumes.
credit-dsp-verify-d5b.approval_ref: data/verify-program-lead-fable-l1/switch-on-plan-1030.md item 1 (l1+v1 GO); firstmate doc-verify-build-b1.inbox 206 + 208: register credit-dsp-verify-d5b as capture-only (approves nothing, writes only its own shadow ledger); live approval use stays a separate r5 GO after a shadow read
credit-dsp-verify-d5b.status_note: SHADOW only: captures + local dsp-anchor/1 records for doc-verify's verified requests, written to dsp-verify.sqlite; it approves nothing and writes no core state (anchor upload stays manual, credit-anchors-push.py). Kill switches /etc/hydra/credit-dsp-verify.disabled and /etc/hydra/credit-verify.disabled. Any LIVE approval use is a separate r5 GO after a shadow read.

credit-verify-outbound.description: scripts/credit-verify-outbound.sh (cron /etc/cron.d/credit-verify-outbound, every 2 h): the server-side OUTBOUND tick for credit verification (captain 2026-10-30 14:4xZ). Sends approved notes (uvn-status ask, R1 receipt; more families as their PRs land) through the deployed gate; it APPROVES NOTHING. Registered for visibility (p1 plan unattended-1030).
credit-verify-outbound.status_note: Approves no credit request. DRY-RUN unless /etc/hydra/credit-verify-outbound.live exists; paid segments also need .paid-enabled; kill switch /etc/hydra/credit-verify-outbound.disabled.

credit-batch-judge.description: scripts/credit_review/batch_judge.py (Fable [key=scale-now-openclaw], consolidated 204): ONE tool-less Codex call per OUTBOUND batch through credit_trust/llm.py (judge-only; never an OpenClaw agent turn), reading every rendered body for COPY + CONSISTENCY only (approved copy ref, barred list, number agreement, facts <-> body <-> first-hits). STOP-ONLY: it approves NO credit request and writes no core, admin or Intercom state; its verdict row is the batch's signature of record and the #1541 tick applies only when may_apply() is true for THAT batch sha.
credit-batch-judge.approved_by: captain (Aaron) 'use openclaw' 2026-10-31 17:5xZ, as batch SIGNER only
credit-batch-judge.approval_ref: Fable [key=scale-now-openclaw] 201 + consolidated final 204 (l1 + p1 + r5); firstmate credit-refresh-t01b.inbox 201-204
credit-batch-judge.status_note: Approves no credit. Signs outbound batches only: fail-closed (UNKNOWN / timeout / finish=length / parse failure / batch-sha mismatch / model off ALLOWED_MODELS / body missing = STOP = no apply). Codex-only ladder on constant models; OpenRouter fallback only through CappedJudge, and a fallback pass never signs the first batch of a class (r5 signs it). SHADOW until b1's eval set (the three hand stops + clean batches) shows its stops cover every hand stop; live from Sun 00Z on that bar.

profile-merge-approver.description: Verb-scoped profile-merge approver: the handle in merge_approver, listed in workspaces/operations/skills/muso-ops-admin/config/merge-approvers.txt, may confirm `muso profiles merge` (POST /admin/profiles/merge) and NOTHING else (muso-cli#64), and only with an --approval-ref naming captain-<id> and decider-<run id> bound to this exact merge, used once. It approves no credit, no track merge and no delete. Used by profile-merge-ops-m1 for captain-approved owner merges (L7) so the audit never reads as the captain having reviewed each case.
profile-merge-approver.approval_ref: firstmate profile-merge-ops-m1.inbox/070 (captain DECIDED YES: fable-decider as the merge approver, scoped to `profiles merge`, bound to the decider record, tier-2 list NOT widened); Fable 048 rule C7 (the coded decider decides, core verifySelfMerge is the single predicate); muso-cli#64 + this PR
profile-merge-approver.status_note: ON for `profiles merge` only (captain 2026-10-30 12:4xZ). Never on tier2-approvers.txt, so it grants no delete, no bulk-destructive verb and no track merge. Effective only once node-8 runs a muso-cli release containing #64: on an older CLI the handle is simply refused (fail closed), it is not silently widened.
